findings.quote: A **solid** has length, width, and depth. Its outside can have flat faces or curved surfaces. A **net** is a flat pattern that folds into the outside of a solid without faces overlapping. Mental Rotation and 3D Visualization teaches cube nets. Here, we will fold a different solid.
